name: Prism 16 - Knowledge Base Service
description: Org-scoped knowledge base semantic search: Gemini embeddings + Supabase pgvector match_documents RPC filtered by organization_id. Standard Prism envelope with clean refusals. Fixes the cross-tenant leak in the legacy unscoped KB tool.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query_embedding: $('Embed Query via Gemini').first().json.embedding && $('Embed Query via Gemini').first().json.embedding.values, match_count: $('Gate & Build Request').first().json.matchCount || 5, p_organization_id: $('Gate & Build Request').first().json.kbOrganizationId || null }) }}

parameters.content:
## Knowledge Base Service (org-scoped)
Embeds the query with Gemini, then searches the organization knowledge base via the org-scoped match_documents RPC (p_organization_id). Returns the standard Prism envelope.
